title: Desk Guidance: When the Charge for a New Household Driver Begins on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
On a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, the charged days of a driver addition charge run to the term expiration date. They start from a date that depends on when the addition took effect and when the household member was reported.

## Rule

The charged days of a driver addition start from a date set as follows, the first matching line deciding:

- **Before the term.** Where the addition took effect before the current term began, they start from the term expiration date, so nothing is charged; the driver is carried in the term premium already written.
- **Reported in time.** Where the driver addition was recorded no more calendar days after its effective date than the package's household driver report days, they start from that effective date, the member having been reported in time. The effective date is the day the member became licensed or moved in.
- **Otherwise.** They start from the date it was recorded, the day the household member was reported.

| Package | Household driver report days |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 30 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 30 |

The effective date and recorded date are those on the driver addition entry; the term dates are those of the term the addition falls in.

## Both sides of the 30-day line (hypothetical; term 1 January to 1 July 2026)

| Member licensed or moved in (effective date) | Addition recorded | Days between | Charged days start | Charged days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2026 | 31 March 2026 | 30 | 1 March 2026 | 122 |
| 1 March 2026 | 1 April 2026 | 31 | 1 April 2026 | 91 |
| 20 December 2025 | 10 January 2026 | 21 | Term expiration date (effective before the term began) | 0 |
